stories.title: EN DIRECT - Mobilisation des lycéens : les cours «totalement ou partiellement suspendus» dans 375 établissements, Braun-Pivet appelle les policiers «à la retenue»

en.title: LIVE - High school student mobilization: classes "totally or partially suspended" in 375 establishments, Braun-Pivet calls on police "to show restraint"
en.summary: High school and student representatives are maintaining pressure over lack of concrete measures, with a fourth wave of mobilization planned Thursday in Paris and other cities.

stories.title: Guerre en Ukraine : des frappes russes sur des bus font au moins 30 morts dans l’est du pays, Kiev également ciblée

en.title: War in Ukraine: Russian strikes on buses kill at least 30 in the east, Kyiv also targeted
en.summary: Russian glide bombs struck two buses in Kramatorsk, a key eastern front city, killing at least 30 people on Thursday. Kyiv was also targeted in the attacks.

stories.title: Espace : Sophie Adenot bientôt de retour sur Terre

en.title: Space: Sophie Adenot soon returning to Earth
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot is returning to Earth after eight months aboard the International Space Station, landing off California on Thursday, October 8, following 235 days in space, a European record.

stories.title: Au moins 30 morts dans une frappe russe sur un bus à Kramatorsk, dans l'est de l'Ukraine

en.title: At least 30 dead in Russian strike on bus in Kramatorsk, eastern Ukraine
en.summary: Russian forces struck a bus in Kramatorsk, killing at least 30 people who were going about their daily activities, according to local military administration.

stories.title: Une frappe russe sur deux bus et un immeuble fait 12 morts à Kramatorsk, dans l’est de l’Ukraine

en.title: Russian strike on two buses and building kills 12 in Kramatorsk, eastern Ukraine
en.summary: Russian forces struck two buses and a building in Kramatorsk, resulting in 12 deaths. The attack follows previous Russian strikes that killed 30 people across Ukraine, including 22 in a residential building in Pryluky.

stories.title: Sécheresse : le gouvernement annonce des prêts à taux zéro pour les agriculteurs

en.title: Drought: government announces zero-interest loans for farmers
en.summary: The Agriculture Minister presented zero-interest loan assistance for drought-affected farmers. The measure can cover up to two billion euros in lending.

stories.title: La ministre de l'Agriculture annonce des prêts à taux zéro pour soutenir les agriculteurs touchés par la sécheresse

en.title: Agriculture Minister announces zero-interest loans to support farmers affected by drought
en.summary: Zero-interest loans worth up to two billion euros will help drought-affected farmers purchase fodder and inputs. The measure requires budget approval to take effect.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : deux bus de ligne visés par une attaque russe à Kramatorsk, au moins 30 morts

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: two buses targeted in Russian attack in Kramatorsk, at least 30 dead
en.summary: Russian forces attacked civilian buses in Kramatorsk carrying people traveling for everyday purposes. The strike resulted in at least 30 deaths and 18 injured, according to the city mayor.

stories.title: Agriculture : le gouvernement annonce de nouvelles aides pour tenter de désamorcer la crise sociale consécutive à la sécheresse

en.title: Agriculture: government announces new aid to defuse social crisis following drought
en.summary: The agriculture minister announced measures in response to farmer demands, including zero-interest treasury loans to address difficulties caused by drought conditions.

stories.title: «Acte IV» de la mobilisation lycéenne, retour sur Terre de Sophie Adenot, Nobel de littérature… L’actu de ce jeudi 8 octobre au matin

en.title: Fourth act of high school mobilization, Sophie Adenot returns to Earth, literature Nobel Prize… News this Thursday October 8 morning
en.summary: A news digest covering multiple current events including ongoing high school protests, astronaut Sophie Adenot's return, and the literature Nobel Prize announcement.

stories.title: Au moins 28 morts, dont cinq enfants, dans une frappe russe sur un immeuble à Prylouky, dans le nord de l'Ukraine

en.title: At least 28 dead, including five children, in Russian strike on building in Prylouky, northern Ukraine
en.summary: A Russian attack on a residential building in Ukraine resulted in at least 28 deaths and dozens of injuries, including multiple children, according to President Zelensky.

stories.title: Lycées, gazole, électricité, budget... Ce qu'il faut retenir de l'allocution du Premier ministre, Sébastien Lecornu

en.title: High schools, diesel, electricity, budget... What to remember from Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu's address
en.summary: The head of government promised to announce initial decisions by the end of October in response to high school student mobilization.

stories.title: Une année d’apprentissage en plus : le CAE propose de réinvestir les économies liées à la baisse des élèves

en.title: One additional year of apprenticeship: the CAE proposes to reinvest savings linked to declining student numbers
en.summary: An economic analysis council proposes allocating 4 billion euros annually to school reforms funded by savings from declining enrollment, aiming to improve student outcomes and reduce social inequalities over ten years.

stories.title: MB Therapeutics décroche son sésame pour industrialiser l’impression 3D de médicaments

en.title: MB Therapeutics obtains approval to industrialize 3D printing of medications
en.summary: The French personalized medicine company received regulatory authorization from the national drug safety agency to advance its 3D-printed medication manufacturing process.

stories.title: Traitement de l'eau : à Gravelines, l'usine SNF Flocryl s'étend pour répondre à un marché croissant

en.title: Water treatment: SNF Flocryl plant expands in Gravelines to meet growing market demand
en.summary: SNF Flocryl is constructing a new manufacturing facility at its Gravelines site to increase production of molecules used in water management and the paper industry.

stories.title: Automobile : OPmobility dévisse en Bourse après un projet de 770 suppressions de postes

en.title: Automotive: OPmobility stock tumbles after announcing 770 job cuts
en.summary: OPmobility's share price fell following a profit warning and plans for workforce reductions in France and Germany, including cuts to hydrogen and alternative powertrain research.

stories.title: Artisanat : l’IA au service du savoir-faire, malgré les réticences

en.title: Craftsmanship: AI in service of expertise, despite reservations
en.summary: Artisanal trades are gradually adopting data and AI tools to improve business management amid economic uncertainty, though adoption faces barriers including apprehension and insufficient training and time resources.
